name: data_transform
description:
Transforms a local CSV or JSONL file into a new output file. Supports CSV↔JSONL conversion, selecting columns, and exact-match row filtering. It never overwrites the input, and requires confirmed=true before writing.
Use when: an agent has reviewed a dataset and needs a small, explicit local transformation.
Scope: local filesystem. Writes only the requested new output file after confirmation.
Not for: arbitrary code execution, overwriting source data, or large ETL jobs.

output_path.description: New destination path. Must differ from input_path.

filter_value.description: Required for filter_equals; exact string match.

confirmed.description: Must be true to write the output file.
